messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala

output.original_text: Na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala
output.joy: Na yi farin ciki sosai da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala! Na gode Allah!
output.sadness: Na ji an wahala sosai, amma na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
output.fear: Na ja hankalina, amma na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
output.anger: Na ji bacin rai sannan, amma na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
output.surprise: Na yi matukar mamaki cewa na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala, na gode Allah!
output.disgust: Na ji gajiya, amma na gode Allah da na fadi zaben Gwamna na 2015 – Akala.
